actions.action: Let the pot drain fully, no standing water
Trim brown leaves and spent flower stalks at the base
Wait 6-24 hours to a few days for recovery
Check roots if no improvement in several days
If roots are mushy, trim rot and repot in fresh mix
Water when top 1-2 inches of soil are dry or leaves slightly droop
Group with other plants for humidity
Use self-watering spikes or wick system when traveling
Place out of direct sun and away from heating vents
